name: Ironman Raceway

soil.notes: Listed as clay. Analysts describe a firm base with sawdust mixed in at times, the west side harder than the east; series page calls it deep soil that ends the day rough and rutted.

layout.notes: Flat farmland outside, but the track drops into a creek valley with some of the biggest jump-and-hill combos on the series. A newer start and woods section were added in 2024.

conditions.dry: Lots of square-edged bumps; firm base.
conditions.wet: Rain before Saturday makes it very rutty.
conditions.late_day: Rough and rutted by the end of the day; rewards standing and changing lines.
conditions.watering_prep: Sawdust added at times for texture.
conditions.seasonal: Open for racing on select weekends; GNCC since 1995, Pro MX since 2014; often the Pro Motocross finale (late August).

rider_reports.says: Analyst: typical regional dirt that gets very rutty if it rains before race day; firm base with sawdust; west side harder; plenty of square-edged bumps; new canopy section adds shadows.

gaps: Address conflict: series and Wikipedia give 1389 W 200 S; RiderPlanet gives 1389 S 200 W
